assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A text-only SQL correctness review against the supplied business-metric definition.
assessments.rationale: This is a sprint-retrospective facilitation procedure. It supplies no SQL or metric-conformance analysis, ranked technical findings, or coverage of the requested failure modes.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A focused query-text conformance review with ranked findings for joins, deduplication, nulls, time, slowly changing attributes, and access controls.
assessments.rationale: It usefully inventories inherited grain, filters, date basis, identity, and possible join fan-out, but frames the requested code review as a different skill and lacks the specified query-correctness taxonomy and finding output.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A text-only SQL review against a business-metric definition, with ranked correctness findings.
assessments.rationale: This is a gene-set enrichment analysis workflow for ranked gene lists and plots, not an analytics SQL correctness review.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A no-run, no-rewrite review of SQL correctness against the supplied metric definition across the specified semantic failure modes.
assessments.rationale: It can inspect query shape and mentions join-related cost drivers, but it is an execution-plan performance-tuning workflow that requires EXPLAIN evidence and delivers rewrites and index DDL rather than metric-conformance findings.
assessments.source_anchor: Diagnoses slow SQL from the execution plan

assessments.rationale: It directly reviews analytics SQL as text against a locked metric definition, produces graded findings without execution or a production rewrite, and explicitly covers grain, join cardinality and fan-out, filters, nulls, time, SCDs, and security or scope.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A focused review of one SQL query against the supplied business-metric definition, with ranked semantic findings.
assessments.rationale: This audits an entire knowledge base for record drift and explicitly distinguishes that task from reviewing one code object against a contract.
assessments.source_anchor: Do NOT fire to review ONE piece of code against the contract

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A no-run, no-rewrite metric-conformance review that covers calendar or timezone, slowly changing attributes, and access controls as well as query semantics.
assessments.rationale: It addresses accidental cross joins, duplicate multiplicity, and NULL behavior, but its purpose is performance rewriting, requires EXPLAIN and equivalence runs, and omits the business-definition review scope requested.
assessments.source_anchor: Reshape a slow query into a faster equivalent

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A ranked SQL-to-business-metric correctness review covering grain, joins, deduplication, filters, time, and slowly changing attributes without implementing changes.
assessments.rationale: It is an implementation-oriented application-security workflow. Authorization is only one requested concern; it neither reviews analytic SQL against a metric definition nor returns the required correctness findings.
